snippet.title: I made a Fantasy Visual Novel Game using Fungus in Unity
snippet.description:
This is my new game avaliable for free in both PC and WebGL in Itch.io: https://mohd-asif.itch.io/souldblade-assandant-visual-novel

This game is inspired by upcoming game Soulblade Assandant which will be 3D Linear story based Hack and Slash game which currently I'm working on. But meanwhile I thought why not make a Visual Novel version of the same game so here you go. I tweek the story a little bit add choices and compressed it and made it into a 3 Episodes story.
